name: csharp-concepts-over-primitives
description: A domain value on a command is modeled as a ConceptAs<T> concept, not a raw string.
prompt: Add an AuthorName value for the author's name and use it in the RegisterAuthor command in Source/Authors/Registration.cs. Write the code to files.
expected_output: An AuthorName record deriving from ConceptAs<string>, used as the RegisterAuthor parameter type.
